## Summary

Describe the behavior and why the change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Rust formatting, Clippy, tests, and checks pass with `--locked`
- [ ] Windows, Linux, and macOS package builds succeed when native code changed

## Risk

- [ ] Privacy or external data flow reviewed
- [ ] Security boundary reviewed
- [ ] Release and migration impact documented
- [ ] No customer documents, credentials, runtime data, or generated files added
